case-events.title: Atmosphere is everything
case-events.intro: A creative exploration of the way spaces make people feel before anyone says a word.
case-events.description: We think of atmosphere as a series of choices working together. Where the eye goes first. What people hear when they walk in. How they find their way. When the energy rises and when the room gets a moment to breathe. None of it happens by accident. This study explores how a cohesive creative concept might move through spatial layout, lighting, styling, staging and guest experience. It is a reminder that the strongest event design is not just about what a place looks like. It is about what happens to people while they are in it.
case-events.quote: Set the scene. Change the feeling.

case-identity.title: Elmboog Organiese Boerdery
case-identity.intro: A connected identity for Elmboog Organiese Boerdery, brought to life through a brand guide, company profile, stationery and presentation design.
case-identity.description:
Give Elmboog a recognisable visual language across the materials people see, read and hold. The identity needed to connect the farm’s name and organic character with a consistent approach to everyday communication.

The work brings together a circular grape-and-field mark, a practical colour palette, typography and an organic flowing pattern, documented in a brand guide.

case-production.title: Behind every moment
case-production.intro: A creative study celebrating the work that makes a live experience run like it was meant to.
case-production.description: The audience comes for the experience. The cables, cue sheets, timing checks and technical conversations are not the headline. They are what allows the headline to happen. This study explores the relationship between creative vision and production craft. How lighting, sound, visuals, people and precision come together to create a moment that feels natural. Our favourite kind of technical excellence is the kind you do not have to think about while you are enjoying the show.
case-production.quote: Behind the scenes. Ahead of the moment.
